en.name: Dome Keeper
en.short_description: Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!

tc.name: Dome Keeper 穹頂守護者
tc.short_description: 走進獨樹一格的類Rogue採礦動作遊戲，抵禦一波接一波外星怪物的攻擊。挖掘資源，收集實用裝置並升級裝備，不斷提高你存活下來的可能性。切記，要在穹頂被摧毀前及時趕回來！

en.name: Dinkum
en.short_description: Dinkum is a survival life simulation game set on an island inspired by the rugged Australian outback. Farm, hunt, mine, fish, and forage to gather resources, expand your town, and discover what makes Dinkum so special—either solo or with friends.

tc.name: Dinkum(金墾小鎮)
tc.short_description: Dinkum 以原始的澳洲內陸為靈感，是一款島嶼生活與生存的模擬遊戲。 玩家需透過務農、狩獵、採礦、捕魚和囤糧以收集資源、擴大城鎮，並發現 Dinkum 如此特別的原因——可與朋友一起，或獨自進行。

en.name: 911 Operator
en.short_description: Game about the difficult work of people that manage emergency lines and services. Answer incoming calls and react properly - give first aid instructions, advise, dispatch correct number of firemen / police / ambulances, or sometimes - just ignore the call. Play on ANY CITY in the world!

Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed...

en.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
en.short_description: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping the city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant, expansive world in this standalone entry of the FFVII remake trilogy.

tc.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
tc.short_description: 克勞德一行人脫離魔晄都市米德加，踏進廣袤的世界展開旅程。 本作有全新的故事、在廣闊世界中的自由冒險以及增進與夥伴間情誼的戰鬥， 帶來繼《FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE》之後更加進化的遊戲體驗。

en.name: Wargame: Red Dragon
en.short_description: The new reference in RTS at its best! The Wargame series returns to duty, larger, richer and more spectacular than ever before. In Wargame Red Dragon, you are engaged in a large-scale conflict where Western forces clash against the Communist bloc.

tc.name: Wargame: Red Dragon
tc.short_description: The new reference in RTS at its best! The Wargame series returns to duty, larger, richer and more spectacular than ever before. In Wargame Red Dragon, you are engaged in a large-scale conflict where Western forces clash against the Communist bloc.

en.name: Project CARS 2
en.short_description: THE ULTIMATE DRIVER JOURNEY! Project CARS 2 delivers the soul of motor racing in the world’s most beautiful, authentic, and technically-advanced racing game.

tc.name: Project CARS 2
tc.short_description: 終極車手之旅 《Project CARS 2》是一款全球最美麗、最逼真，技術最先進的賽車遊戲，為玩家獻上貨真價實的專業賽車手體驗。你可以體驗多樣化的比賽種類、登峰造極的賽車技術、根據動態變化即時改變的賽道等等，豐富的遊戲模式。

en.name: Armello
en.short_description: Armello is a grim fairy-tale board game come to life, with every match combining deep, tactical card play, rich tabletop strategy and RPG elements. Leverage subterfuge, spells and careful strategy to wrangle control of the game's chaotic odds as you quest for the throne.

tc.name: Armello
tc.short_description: 愛門羅是一款嚴肅且風格奇幻，栩栩如生的棋盤遊戲。充滿著虛張聲勢並結合了深度策略的冒險，戰術性紙牌行動，豐富的棋盤策略與RPG要素。進行史詩般單人模式或多人對戰模式，施放咒術，雇用特務，並且準備好毒藥與計謀來追求寶座任務吧！

en.name: Car For Sale Simulator
en.short_description: Buy used cars and motorcycles, negotiate with sellers, and discover each vehicle’s true value. Drive, repair, repaint, and customize your vehicles before selling them for a profit. Start with a small office, grow your dealership, and become the city’s most successful vehicle dealer!

tc.name: 汽車經銷商模擬器
tc.short_description: 《Car For Sale Simulator》是专为汽车爱好者开发的游戏，您可以通过购买和销售不同的汽车模型来发展自己的汽车销售业务。您可以按照自己的意愿驾驶、修理、改装并以合适的价格卖给顾客购买的汽车。

en.name: Duke Nukem Forever
en.short_description: The King arrives with an arsenal of over-the-top weapons, giant explosions and pure unadulterated fun!

tc.name: Duke Nukem Forever
tc.short_description: The King arrives with an arsenal of over-the-top weapons, giant explosions and pure unadulterated fun!

en.name: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
en.short_description: Join the young king Evan as he sets out on an epic quest to found a new kingdom and, with the help of some new friends, unite his world, saving its people from a terrible evil.

tc.name: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
tc.short_description: 化身年轻国王Evan，为自己立了个宏伟的使命，寻找建立新的国度，与一同冒险犯难的伙伴们，将国家团结起来、拯救人民逃离恶魔的魔掌。

en.name: Montaro
en.short_description: Montaro is a DOGE.

tc.name: Montaro
tc.short_description: 咚咚咚咚向前奔跑,超可愛的柴犬夢太郎療癒你的心!

en.name: Path Of Wuxia
en.short_description: Path of Wuxia combines classic wuxia world and youthful school life with anime art style, features simulation gameplay well known by Heluo fans. Play as a young Xia who join the academy known as the Hermitic Pavilions of Xia, grow strong along with various schoolmates and seek your own path of Xia.
developers: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司

tc.name: 俠之道(PathOfWuxia)
tc.short_description: 《俠之道》是河洛工作室繼《俠客風雲傳》系列後推出的第四部單機作品，本次遊戲再度回歸系列玩家熟悉的養成玩法，以新穎的動漫畫風將武俠世界觀與青春校園生活相結合，扮演初入武林便身懷絕技的的少年俠客，拜入名為俠隱閣的武俠書院，與各色同儕砥礪成長，追尋心目中理想的俠道之路。
developers: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司

en.name: Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales
en.short_description: Discover a brand new RPG from the creators of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Facing an imminent invasion, Meve — war-veteran and Queen of Lyria and Rivia — is forced to once again enter the warpath and set out on a dark journey of destruction and revenge.

tc.name: Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales
tc.short_description: 踏進由《巫師 3：狂獵》團隊創造的全新角色扮演遊戲。戰功彪炳的里瑞亞與利維亞女王梅芙面對來勢洶洶的侵略，必須再次征戰沙場，並展開黑暗的復仇與毀滅之旅。

en.name: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk
en.short_description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

tc.name: Milk inside a bag of milk inside a bag of milk
tc.short_description: A short story about what sort of challenges everyday little things can be. Help the girl buy milk, be the first not to disappoint her.

en.short_description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

tc.short_description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

en.name: Deponia
en.short_description: In Deponia, the world has degenerated into a vast garbage dump, in which the crotchety Rufus ekes out his sorry existence.

tc.name: Deponia
tc.short_description: 在德波尼亞，世界退化成了巨大垃圾堆，壞脾氣的魯夫斯在這裡勉強求生。

en.name: Rabi-Ribi
en.short_description: Dodge bullets, missiles and lasers in battle as you wrap your head around that bunny girl costume! Combo away with your mighty Piko Hammer or spam various spells from afar with your fiery fairy friend. Explore and explode through Rabi-Rabi Island as you collect power-ups and uncover secrets...

tc.name: Rabi-Ribi
tc.short_description: 讓兔耳娘當主角的遊戲總是不嫌多，所以這是款獻給兔耳愛好者的遊戲 — 一款 2D 橫向捲軸 + 平台探險動作遊戲。

en.name: I Love You, Colonel Sanders! A Finger Lickin’ Good Dating Simulator
en.short_description: Welcome to the most delicious dating simulator ever created. Do you have what it takes to be the business partner of and win the heart of the most famous chicken salesman of all time? Play to find out! Go ahead, Colonel Sanders is waiting.

tc.name: I Love You, Colonel Sanders! A Finger Lickin’ Good Dating Simulator
tc.short_description: Welcome to the most delicious dating simulator ever created. Do you have what it takes to be the business partner of and win the heart of the most famous chicken salesman of all time? Play to find out! Go ahead, Colonel Sanders is waiting.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War
en.short_description: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War brings you to a world of terror and violence. Four factions will engage in a brutal war for dominance over the planet’s resources. In the first turn-based 4X strategy game set in Warhammer 40,000 you will lead one of four unique factions.

tc.name: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War

en.name: A Little to the Left
en.short_description: A Little to the Left is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 100+ satisfying messes to tidy.

tc.name: A Little to the Left
tc.short_description: 《靠左一些些》是令人舒心的拼圖遊戲，供您將居家物品分類、堆疊和整理，成為賞心悅目的整齊狀態，同時還得留意一隻調皮的貓咪，經常喜歡搞破壞。快來玩這個有趣又直觀的解謎遊戲，有 100 多種混亂場景可以打理，給人滿滿的成就感。

en.name: Argo
en.short_description: Jump straight into combat in this official standalone FREE total conversion of Arma 3. Argo is a hardcore tactical first-person shooter, in which you fight across unrestricted terrain, and where a single bullet is all it takes. Master your craft to rank up and become (in)famous on the battlefield.

tc.name: Argo
tc.short_description: 在這款改編自 Arma 3 的官方免費獨立遊戲中您可以直接投入戰鬥。Argo 是一款專業的第一人稱戰術射擊遊戲，在遊戲中，您將在毫無限制的戰區作戰，而所要的僅僅是一發子彈。磨煉您的技能，不斷晉升，讓自己的英名（惡名）傳遍戰場。

en.name: Need for Speed™ Most Wanted
en.short_description: The open-world action in Need for Speed Most Wanted gives you the freedom to drive your way. Hit jumps and shortcuts, switch cars, lie low or head for terrain that plays to your vehicle’s unique strengths. Fight your way past cops and rivals using skill, high-end car tech and tons of nitrous.

tc.name: Need for Speed™ Most Wanted
tc.short_description: 繫上安全帶，大腳踩油門，盡情惹麻煩。

en.name: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
en.short_description: Discover the original co-op shooter-looter, crammed with new enhancements! As one of 4 trigger-happy mercenaries with RPG progression, equip bazillions of guns to take on the desert planet Pandora.

tc.name: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
tc.short_description: 快來體驗這款經過全新優化的合作式射擊奪寶遊戲鼻祖吧！扮演4位無法無天的傭兵之一體驗RPG養成要素，裝備無窮盡的槍械征服荒涼的行星Pandora。

en.name: The Wolf Among Us
en.short_description: From the makers of the 2012 Game of the Year: The Walking Dead, comes a thriller based on the award-winning Fables comic books. As Bigby Wolf you will discover that a brutal, bloody murder is just a taste of things to come in a game series where your every decision can have enormous consequences.

tc.name: The Wolf Among Us
tc.short_description: From the makers of the 2012 Game of the Year: The Walking Dead, comes a thriller based on the award-winning Fables comic books. As Bigby Wolf you will discover that a brutal, bloody murder is just a taste of things to come in a game series where your every decision can have enormous consequences.

en.name: Half-Life 2: Lost Coast
en.short_description: Originally planned as a section of the Highway 17 chapter of Half-Life 2, Lost Coast is a playable technology showcase that introduces High Dynamic Range lighting to the Source engine.

tc.name: Half-Life 2: Lost Coast
tc.short_description: 《Lost Coast》原本企劃做為《戰慄時空 2》中「17 號高速公路」遊戲章節的一部分，現在則是導入 Source 引擎所加入的高動態範圍光源之技術展示遊戲。

en.name: Undisputed
en.short_description: Become Undisputed in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

tc.name: Undisputed
tc.short_description: Become Undisputed in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

en.name: 月圆之夜 (Night of Full Moon)
en.short_description: "Night of the Full Moon" is a stand-alone roguelike card game. Take adventure into Black Forest. Random event, random plot leads to different endings.

tc.name: 月圓之夜
tc.short_description: 《月圓之夜》是壹款獨立單機卡牌遊戲，探索，冒險，隨機事件，隨機劇情將會導致不同的結局。七大職業，每個職業有專屬的卡組，專屬的流派，100種獨具特色的怪物，揭秘黑森林的秘密。

en.name: Marvel's Avengers - The Definitive Edition
en.short_description: Assemble your team of Earth’s Mightiest Heroes, embrace your powers, and live your Super Hero dreams.

tc.name: 《漫威復仇者聯盟》：最終版
tc.short_description: 集結地表最強英雄團隊，接受你的力量，實現你的超級英雄夢。

en.name: Unheard - Voices of Crime
en.short_description: What if you could hear every word spoken at the scene of a crime? “Acoustic Detectives” wanted for testing our new device! Return aurally to crime scenes and use the voices you hear to identify potential suspects and solve the mysteries. What is it that’s connecting these seemingly unrelated cases?

tc.name: 疑案追聲
tc.short_description: 如果有一種技術，能夠收集來自案發現場的聲音，那就可以輕易找出幕後黑手，解開神秘懸案。但是，用聲音來推理，遠比想象中要困難。為此，我們在為系統尋找合適的使用者——“聲探”！請你回到案發現場，利用聲音跟蹤每個人的行動，告訴我們，在這些看似毫不相關的案件下，是否還隱藏著一個終極秘密。

en.name: Timberborn
en.short_description: Humans are long gone. In a world struck by droughts and toxic waste, will your lumberpunk beavers do any better? A sandbox city-building game featuring ingenious animals, vertical architecture, water physics, and terraforming. Contains high amounts of wood.

tc.name: 河狸浮生記 Timberborn
tc.short_description: 人類早已不復存在。在這個乾旱和有毒廢料肆虐的世界，你的木匠龐克河狸們的命運又會是如何？這款沙盒城市建造遊戲包含機智的動物、巧妙的垂直建築、多樣化的水物理運用與地形改造。當然還有絕對少不了的大量木材！

en.name: Griftlands
en.short_description: Griftlands is a deck-building roguelite where you negotiate, fight, steal or otherwise persuade others to get your way. Every decision is important, be it the jobs you take, the friends you make, or the cards you collect.

tc.name: 欺詐之地
tc.short_description: 『欺詐之地』是壹款卡牌組建的rogue-like遊戲，妳可以在遊戲中協商、戰鬥、行竊或是說服他人來達到自己的目的。每個決定都至關重要，不管是接受什麽任務、跟誰交朋友、還是收集哪些卡牌。

en.name: Stronghold Crusader 2
en.short_description: Stronghold Crusader 2 is the long awaited sequel to the original castle sim. After 12 years Stronghold returns to the desert with a new 3D engine and powerful Havok Physics. Crusader 2 recaptures the original game’s addictive, fast-paced gameplay and authentic castle simulation.

tc.name: Stronghold Crusader 2
tc.short_description: Stronghold Crusader 2 is the long awaited sequel to the original castle sim. After 12 years Stronghold returns to the desert with a new 3D engine and powerful Havok Physics. Crusader 2 recaptures the original game’s addictive, fast-paced gameplay and authentic castle simulation.

en.name: Dread Hunger
en.short_description: A game of survival and betrayal. Eight Explorers path their ship through the unforgiving Arctic. Among the crew, two traitors call on dark powers to undermine them. Note: Official server support ends 2024-01-01

tc.name: Dread Hunger
tc.short_description: 這是一場關於生存與背叛的遊戲。八位探險家將乘著船隻航行過殘酷的北極，而船上有兩位叛徒呼喚了黑暗的力量，想陷害其他的探險家。注意：官方伺服器支援服務將於 2024 年 1 月 1 日結束

en.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
en.short_description: The Dark Pictures Anthology is a series of stand-alone, branching cinematic horror games that can also be played online with a friend. In Man of Medan, five friends set sail on a holiday diving trip that soon changes into something much more sinister.

tc.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
tc.short_description: 《黑相集》是一系列獨立電影式，帶有多分歧故事情節並且可以與朋友一同連線遊玩的恐怖遊戲。 在《黑相集：棉蘭號》中，五位好友啟程前往假日潛水之旅突然急轉直下，發展成某種不祥的災難。

en.name: Frostpunk 2
en.short_description: Develop, expand, and advance your city in a society survival game set 30 years after an apocalyptic blizzard ravaged Earth. In Frostpunk 2, you face not only the perils of never-ending winter, but also the powerful factions that watch your every step inside the Council Hall.

tc.name: 冰汽時代2
tc.short_description: 地球遭受暴風雪侵襲的30年後，滿目瘡痍的景象宛如世界末日。《冰汽時代2》是款社會生存遊戲，玩家需要在遊戲中發展並壯大自己的城市。除了面對危機四伏的無盡冬霜，玩家還要應付議會廳內部難纏的種種勢力。

en.name: We Happy Few
en.short_description: From the independent studio that brought you Contrast, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England. Hide, fight and conform your way out of this delusional, Joy-obsessed world.

tc.name: We Happy Few
tc.short_description: 由製作的《Contrast》的獨立遊戲創作室呈獻，《We Happy Few》是一個以仿英倫六十年代、具復古未來風格的毒品之城作故事背景的動作／冒險遊戲。隱藏、戰鬥或是順從，設法逃離這個充滿幻覺、沉溺於 Joy 藥劑的世界。

en.name: KinitoPET
en.short_description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

tc.name: KinitoPET
tc.short_description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

en.name: BRAIN / OUT
en.short_description: Brain / Out is a multiplayer shooter with a nostalgic post-Soviet feel. Experience dynamic battles and exterminate your enemies with a large arsenal of modern weaponry. Lock'n'load!

tc.name: BRAIN / OUT

en.name: Who's Your Daddy?!
en.short_description: Who's Your Daddy is a casual multiplayer game featuring a clueless father attempting to prevent his infant son from certain death. Play with up to 7 of your friends, and test your parenting skills in a competitive setup with wacky physics and over 67 potentially ominous household items.

tc.name: Who's Your Daddy?!
tc.short_description: Who's Your Daddy是一款休閒多人遊戲，遊戲中一個毫無頭緒的父親試圖阻止他的嬰兒兒子死亡。與多達7個朋友一起玩，以競爭性設定測試你的育兒技巧，遊戲中有瘋狂的物理效果和超過69個可能具有不祥預兆的家庭用品。

en.name: The Quarry
en.short_description: When the sun goes down on the last night of summer camp, nine teenage counselors are plunged into an unpredictable night of horror. The only thing worse than the blood-drenched locals and creatures hunting them are the unimaginable choices you must make to help them survive.

tc.name: 獵逃驚魂
tc.short_description: 在夏令營的最後一晚，隨著夜幕逐漸低垂，九名年輕的輔導員發現自己陷入了充滿未知變數的恐怖夜晚。除了雙手滿是鮮血的當地人和恐怖怪物的追殺，你還必須做出各種意想不到的艱難選擇，才能讓這群年輕人逃出生天。

en.name: The Test
en.short_description: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal truths from deep within. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?
